up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows from the ChEMBL database for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1795176 (N-lysine methyltransferase KMT5A). For each qualifying row, return the assay ChEMBL identifier, target type, taxonomy ID, canonical SMILES of the compound, molecule ChEMBL identifier, standard activity type, and pChEMBL value. Include only rows where the standard relation is exactly '=' and the pChEMBL value is not null. Order the results first by molecule ChEMBL identifier, then by assay ChEMBL identifier, and limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT a.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID", td.target_type AS "target type", td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES", md.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID", act.standard_type AS "standard type", act.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value"
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795176'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
